house.title: The house
house.intro: A traditional riad restored with care and rented in its entirety: the whole house is yours.
paragraphs: Behind a discreet door in a quiet lane of the medina, the house opens onto a bright courtyard with a plunge pool, orange trees and zellige tiles.
The three bedrooms each have their own character, two bathrooms are shared between them, and the roof terrace is the perfect place for breakfast in the sun or a drink at sunset.

location.title: Location
location.intro: In a quiet lane of the medina, close to everything.

places.airport: Marrakech Menara airport: 20 min by car

location.arrival: Cars cannot enter the narrow lanes of the medina. We meet you at the nearest drop-off point and walk with you to the house.
location.photoAlt: The Koutoubia minaret with the Atlas Mountains behind

rules.title: House rules
items: Children are welcome (the pool is not fenced, please supervise them)

items.q: Do I pay when I send a request?
items.a: No. Your request is free and without commitment. The owner confirms within 24 hours and then explains how to pay.

items.q: Why book here rather than on Airbnb?
items.a: Booking directly is cheaper: there are no platform service fees, and you talk to the owner directly.

items.q: Can you organise an airport transfer?
items.a: Yes, on request. Just mention it in your message when you book.
Breakfast can be served on the terrace on request for a small extra charge.

items.q: How do I find the house?
items.a: We send you precise directions before your arrival and meet you at the nearest drop-off point.
Free cancellation up to 14 days before arrival (placeholder: to be confirmed by the owner).
